chapter: Le Ruban Bleu, retirement and community work
title: An old tape, the outtake album and a film clip of 'Mutiny in the Nursery'
summary: An early-1930s tape is with Alan Eighler; Chertok has the film clip she would like to show.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: It's over at The House That Jazz Built somewhere. He also had a copy, he had a tape of the concert that I did at Lewiston Stadium, the George Gershwin Concert. I sang "Summertime" and "Nights Work If You Can Get It".
When was this?

Oh, in the early thirties right after I became popular. And I had to do an encore and guess what the encore was, "Loch Lomond" and George Gershwin didn't write that there. In fact the reviewer mentioned the fact, you know, that I had to do an encore when "Loch Lomond" certainly wasn't a George Gershwin tune. But I did it. I'm not sure, I think the band was Paul Whiteman I believe, yeah. Oh boy.
So that tape is in existance?
Well Alan Eighler has got it. I've got a copy of it too around the house.
Okay, so that's interesting. Is the sound quality good?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
You can hear it. I'll dig it up. I ran into Phil Schaap and he said he found that A Kiss" thing with "Say It With from the movie.
Yeah. I had spoke to him on the phone.
He said it's on some kind of a label, Out something, Cut-Out something.
I think he told me "Cuts".
Something like that.
Maybe it's "Cut-Outs". The word for film is out-take, isn't it?

Yeah, out-take, yeah. Of A Kiss," course Louie, "Say It With everybody sings it, I sing it, Louie sings it, Dick Powell sings it, Anita Louise sings it too. The whole number. It was supposed to be a sequence in the movie but they cut it out. He also had that clip of "Mutiny In The Nursery" from the same picture.
Dave Chertokck said he has the film clip of that "Mutiny In the Nursery" thing. I'd like to get my hands on that.
He has the whole film, he told me.
Yeah?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Yes.

I sure would like to get a chance to show that, you know. But he travels with his show a little bit out of the reach of our budget. I was hoping I might be able to talk him into coming and doing it for us.
That would be nice.

Yeah. I'd like to really have a clip of that. I thought once, I thought in 1973 when Leonard Feather produced that tribute to Louie Armstrong out at U.C.L.A. and they showed a lot of clips that Louie was in from all the movies from the very early cartoons when he was singing, 'I'll Be Glad When You're Here You Little Rascal You' and had him running through the jungle.
Well, showmanship.
Yeah, showmanship. Boy, what humor.
Well, that's the trouble with that kind of think, it dates a little fast.
Yes.
Whereas a performance can endure.
